title: Package manager
idea: Package manager: Dependency changes show source version and affected projects
audience: People who need to manage package within a desktop surface.
avoidWhen: A decorative install action hides execution
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its manage package priority and explicit commitment contract: Installation success requires process and verification evidence
navigation: Package manager keeps the current manage package context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Dependency changes show source version and affected projects
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to manage package; updates have inspectable compatibility impact
composition.priority: Installation success requires process and verification evidence

imagery.role: Support the actual manage package context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep change summary and rollback path accessible
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the package manager structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no manage package content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Installation success requires process and verification evidence
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized manage package content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Installation success requires process and verification evidence
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active manage package context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
